GetIMChannelsList_200.description: Typical 200 response without the include query parameter. Returns `data` as an array of channel objects with core fields only. All identifiers, contact details, and URLs are synthetic sample values.

GetIMChannelsList_200_withInclude.description: Response when `include` contains `creator`, `configParams`, and `meta`. Optional nested objects are appended per channel. Sensitive config values (tokens, secrets) are masked.

GetIMChannel_200_TELEGRAM.description: 200 response for a Telegram channel. Sensitive config values are masked.

GetIMChannel_200_WHATSAPP.description: 200 response for a WhatsApp channel. Phone number and WABA ID are synthetic sample values.

GetIMChannel_200_IM_TALK.description: 200 response for a Zoho Business Messenger (IM_TALK) channel with CHANNEL_CUSTOMISATION meta.

GetIMChannel_200_FACEBOOKMESSENGER.description: 200 response for a Facebook Messenger channel. User and page names are synthetic.

GetIMChannel_200_INSTAGRAM.description: 200 response for an Instagram channel. Business account and user identifiers are synthetic.

GetIMChannel_200_WECHAT.description: 200 response for a WeChat channel. Secrets and tokens are masked or synthetic.

GetIMChannel_200_LINE.description: 200 response for a LINE channel. Channel secret and access token are masked.

UpdateIMChannel_nameOnly.description: Minimal update payload changing only the channel name.

UpdateIMChannel_telegram.description: Update Telegram channel name and bot auth token. Token value is a placeholder.

UpdateIMChannel_imTalk_meta.description: Update CHANNEL_CUSTOMISATION meta for a Business Messenger channel.

UpdateIMChannel_defaultBotId.description: Assign or change the default bot for the channel.

GetIMChannel_200_TELEGRAM_withCreator.description: 200 response with `include=creator`. Embeds the agent who created the channel. PII masked with synthetic sample values.

GetIMChannel_200_TELEGRAM_withPreference.description: 200 response with `include=preference`. Embeds channel routing and handling preferences. PII masked with synthetic sample values.

CreateIMChannel_telegram.description: Create a Telegram channel with bot auth token. Token value is masked.

CreateIMChannel_whatsappSandbox.description: Create a WhatsApp sandbox channel without configParams. Set isSandBox to true.

CreateIMChannel_wechat.description: Create a WeChat channel with required credential configParams. Placeholder values must be replaced with credentials from your WeChat developer account.

CreateIMChannel_line.description: Create a LINE channel with channel ID and secret from the LINE Developers console.

CreateIMChannel_imTalk.description: Create a Business Messenger (IM_TALK) channel with an empty configParams array.

CreateIMChannel_whatsapp.description: Create a WhatsApp channel with PHONE_NUMBER configParam. Obtain the phone number by calling GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/WHATSAPP/details for WABA list, then GET /api/v1/im/integrationServices/WHATSAPP/phonenumbers with query parameter wabaId. If no WABA or phone numbers are returned, complete Facebook embedded signup from the Desk UI.

GetIMChannelHandlingAgents_200.description: 200 response listing agents assigned to handle the IM channel. PII masked with synthetic sample values.

AddIMChannelHandlingAgents_request.description: Request body with agent IDs to assign as handling agents for the channel.

RemoveIMChannelHandlingAgents_request.description: Request body with agent IDs to remove from handling agents for the channel.

AddIMChannelsHandlingAgents_request.description: Assigns handling agents to multiple IM channels. Agent and channel IDs are synthetic sample values.

RemoveIMChannelsHandlingAgents_request.description: Removes handling agents from multiple IM channels. Agent and channel IDs are synthetic sample values.

AssociateIMChannel_request.description: Request body to map an IM channel to a Desk department after channel creation. Department ID is a synthetic sample value.

GetIMChannelPreference_200.description: 200 response with routing, business hours, and ticket conversion preferences. PII masked with synthetic sample values.

GetIMChannelPreference_200_singleTicket.description: 200 response when autoTicketConvertInterval is always (-1): a single ticket is used without a timed interval for converting chats into new tickets. PII masked with synthetic sample values.

SaveIMChannelPreference_routingAndTicket.description: Enables sequential chat routing and the timer for converting chats into new tickets after 30min of inactivity. A new ticket is created when the customer responds after this period. Business hours disabled. IDs are synthetic sample values.

SaveIMChannelPreference_singleTicket.description: Sets autoTicketConvertInterval to always (-1) so chats use a single ticket without a timed interval for new ticket conversion. IDs are synthetic sample values.

SaveIMChannelPreference_businessHours.description: Enables business hours for the channel and keeps chat routing on. Timer for converting chats into new tickets disabled (NONE via autoTicketConvert false). IDs are synthetic sample values.

SaveIMChannelPreference_200.description: 200 response after saving admin preferences (same shape as GET). PII masked with synthetic sample values.
